headline: DPSC Limited announces appointment of a whole-time director in its material subsidiary
summary: DPSC Limited has disclosed a material corporate development regarding the appointment of a whole-time director within one of its material subsidiary companies. The filing provides formal notification to the exchange in compliance with disclosure norms. Routine board-level appointments at subsidiaries rarely impact near-term stock performance. Retail investors holding the stock should note the corporate governance update.
why_it_matters: Routine subsidiary management update with no immediate financial impact

headline: DPSC Limited reports director office vacation in material subsidiary IPCL Power
hook: Subsidiary board vacancy at DPSC Limited
summary: DPSC Limited has announced that directors have vacated their offices in its material subsidiary, IPCL Power Limited. The disclosure was submitted as a general update to the stock exchanges. No further financial or operational impact details were provided in the filing. Indian retail investors holding DPSC Limited should note governance changes in subsidiaries, though immediate stock price impact is typically minimal without operational disruption.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary board changes require monitoring for governance stability.
